## Shared scenes

> [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) returns home from a party where she enjoyed a lively argument with [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). Upon arriving, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reveals that [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) proposed to her and begs [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) to release her from her solemn promise never to marry, but [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) fiercely refuses. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) sends John a cold refusal, leaving both [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and John heartbroken while [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) tries to justify her refusal to her cat.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXII. ST. GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT

GEORGE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P41](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0041)_

> [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) confronts [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), asking her to release [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) from her past promise so they can marry, to which [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) agrees. When [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) returns home and informs [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) feels remorseful and tries to suggest contacting [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md). However, when [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) refuses to move in with Norman and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md), [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) declares she will not leave [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) alone and refuses to marry Norman.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE

> [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to ask her to marry her father, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), willing to risk having a stepmother for her father's happiness. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she will be a friend rather than a cruel stepmother and gives her a note for her father, which restores John Meredith's spirits upon receiving it.
